newsitem.title: UK: Sedgwick, Nikols in Latam, S.Europe venture.
newsitem.headline: Sedgwick, Nikols in Latam, S.Europe venture.

text.p: British insurance company Sedgwick Group Plc said on Monday it agreed to merge some of its operations with Italy's Nikols Brichetto Group to form a joint venture in southern Europe and Latin America.
Sedgwick said the venture would enhance its earnings in 1998.
Sedgwick said the deal would involve the merger of some of its risk services, insurance and reinsurance broking and employee benefits consulting operations with those of Nikols.
The venture will operate initially from offices in Italy, Spain, Portugal, Argentina, Brazil, Chile and Colombia.
Completion was expected before the end of the year.
Nikols and Sedgwick will contribute businesses to the venture. In addition, Sedgwick expected to make a 10 million stg balancing payment to Securfin on completion.
Nikols chairman Letizia Moratti will serve as executive chairman of the joint venture company, Nikols Sedgwick BV, and join Sedgwick's board.
A unit of the Moratti family's Securfin SpA will own 51 percent of the joint venture.
Sedgwick directors will have a majority of the voting rights at meetings of the board, and the venture's holding company will be fully consolidated into Sedgwick's results.
Sedgwick said the deal would lead to an increased flow of business to its London market operations.

"The joint venture will offer considerable opportunities for our employee benefits business for which there is significant growth potential in the southern European markets," chairman Sax Riley said in a statement.
For its part, Nikols said it would be able to offer clients a global service through its partnership with Sedgwick. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
